conclusion: Strict Record additivity forbids every interaction term, so no source action is a scalar readout. The minimal position-carrying extension is a two-body kernel; lattice covariance reduces it at nearest-neighbor range to a single constant, the adjacent-pair count. That functional is additive only for separated collections, it supplies a site-anchored value as the marginal cost of a test record, and the field operator it induces lies in the same two-dimensional family the law-side classification gives.
site_anchored_readout_shape: the field at a site is the marginal readout cost of a test record placed there; at an empty site it is defined only through that test record
